title: Balancing Engagement and Polarization: Multi-Objective Alignment of News Content Using LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Scoring original and LLM-generated news articles on a 1-10 scale for political polarization and left/right-leaning editorial slant using LLMs (GPT-4o-mini, Gemini, Claude) as judges alongside human annotators, and analyzing how optimizing content for user engagement impacts these ideological slant scores.
